card.name: Count nouns right after a number
card.fires_on: The noun or adjective right after a large number, mostly 'people', 'patients' or 'different'. It appears in both web text and trial-style label text.

modes.label: People or patients after a count
modes.description: The word 'people' or 'patients' directly follows a numeral giving a group size.
modes.example: 240<< patients>> treated with pazopanib tablets experienced

modes.label: 'different' after a count
modes.description: The word 'different' follows a numeral and comes before a plural noun such as species or medicines.
modes.example: The company makes more than 2,400<< different>> medicines sold throughout the U.S.

card.plain: It marks the spot just after a number where the text says what is being counted, such as people, patients or kinds.
